100cims-page.hero-subtitle: The app to track your progress on the 100 Cims challenge and dozens of other summit lists across Catalonia and the world. Free, iOS and Android.
100cims-page.what-is-p1: Climbing the 100 Cims is a Catalan hiking tradition: a curated list of one hundred representative peaks inviting you to discover the country on foot. From easy hills that take a few hours to Pyrenean summits above 3,000 metres, the list covers the whole Catalan territory.
100cims-page.what-is-p2: Cims, sempre amunt is an app that makes tracking your ascents simple. You mark summits as done, add a photo and date, and watch your progress grow. Beyond the 100 Cims, you'll find many other challenges like Sostres Comarcals, Essential Peaks, Top Spain and more.
100cims-page.step-1-body: Available free on the App Store and Google Play. No complicated signup — log in with Apple or Google and you're ready.
100cims-page.step-2-body: Choose the 100 Cims challenge or any other available list. You can follow several challenges at once and switch between them whenever you want.
100cims-page.step-3-body: When you reach the summit, open the app, add a photo and the date. Your progress updates automatically and you can share it with whoever you want.
100cims-page.featured-title: Some of the peaks you'll find
100cims-page.featured-subtitle: A small sample from the catalog — inside the app you'll find hundreds of peaks with complete info, map and route.
100cims-page.faq-1-a: The 100 Cims are a popular curated list of one hundred representative mountains of Catalonia. They include peaks from every region with varied difficulty, designed so anyone motivated can complete the challenge at their own pace.
100cims-page.faq-2-a: No. Cims, sempre amunt is an independent passion project. It has no affiliation with FEEC (Federació d'Entitats Excursionistes de Catalunya) or any federation. For official validation such as the FEEC diploma, you need to arrange it with them directly.
100cims-page.faq-3-q: How much does the app cost?
100cims-page.faq-3-a: The app is completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. The project is supported by voluntary donations from users who want to help.
100cims-page.faq-4-q: Which platforms is it available on?
100cims-page.faq-4-a: iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. Download it from the App Store or Google Play.
100cims-page.faq-5-q: What about summits I did before installing the app?
100cims-page.faq-5-a: You can log ascents retroactively. In each summit form you can set the real date you climbed it and add a photo if you have one. Your progress recalculates automatically.
100cims-page.faq-6-q: Are there challenges beyond the 100 Cims?
100cims-page.faq-6-a: Yes. Beyond the 100 Cims you'll find Sostres Comarcals, Essential Peaks, Top Spain, Cumbres Astures, Altos Madrileños and others. Follow as many as you want — the same ascent counts for every challenge that contains it.
100cims-page.faq-7-a: The app runs on trust: you log your own ascents with photo and date. There's no mandatory GPS check or external validation. It's a personal tracking tool, not an official competition.
100cims-page.disclaimer: Cims, sempre amunt is not affiliated with or endorsed by FEEC or any federation.
100cims-page.cta-subtitle: Install the app, pick your challenge and start logging your summits. Free, ad-free, made by hikers.

three-peaks-page.hero-subtitle: The free, ad-free app to track your progress on the UK's National Three Peaks — Ben Nevis, Scafell Pike and Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon). Available on iOS and Android.
three-peaks-page.what-is-title: What is the National Three Peaks Challenge?
three-peaks-page.what-is-p1: The National Three Peaks Challenge is a classic British mountaineering challenge: climb the highest peak of Scotland (Ben Nevis, 1,345 m), England (Scafell Pike, 978 m) and Wales (Yr Wyddfa — also called Snowdon, 1,085 m). Tradition says you do all three in 24 hours, but many walkers spread it over a weekend or a full week.
three-peaks-page.what-is-p2: Cims, sempre amunt is an app that makes tracking the Three Peaks — and every other list you care about — simple. Mark each summit as done, add a photo and date, and watch your progress grow. You'll also find dozens of other challenges across the UK, Europe and beyond, all in the same place.
three-peaks-page.step-1-body: Free on the App Store and Google Play. No complicated signup — log in with Apple or Google and you're ready in seconds.
three-peaks-page.step-2-body: Follow the National Three Peaks challenge inside the app. You can follow several challenges at once and switch between them whenever you like.
three-peaks-page.step-3-body: When you reach a summit, open the app, add a photo and the date. Your progress updates automatically and you can share it with whoever you want.
three-peaks-page.featured-subtitle: Ben Nevis in the Scottish Highlands, Yr Wyddfa in Eryri (Snowdonia) and Scafell Pike in the Lake District — the three highest points of Scotland, Wales and England.
three-peaks-page.faq-1-q: What exactly is the National Three Peaks Challenge?
three-peaks-page.faq-1-a: It's a popular British mountaineering challenge: summit the highest peak of each of the three nations — Ben Nevis (Scotland, 1,345 m), Yr Wyddfa / Snowdon (Wales, 1,085 m) and Scafell Pike (England, 978 m). Classically attempted within 24 hours including travel, but plenty of people take a weekend or longer.
three-peaks-page.faq-2-q: Is this app officially endorsed by the National Trust or any mountain authority?
three-peaks-page.faq-2-a: No. Cims, sempre amunt is an independent passion project with no affiliation to the National Trust, John Muir Trust, Snowdonia National Park or any other organisation. If you want official recognition or a certificate, look at charity-run Three Peaks events.
three-peaks-page.faq-3-q: How much does the app cost?
three-peaks-page.faq-3-a: The app is completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. The project is supported by voluntary donations from users who want to help.
three-peaks-page.faq-4-q: Which platforms is it available on?
three-peaks-page.faq-4-a: iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. Download it from the App Store or Google Play.
three-peaks-page.faq-5-q: Can I log Three Peaks I did before installing the app?
three-peaks-page.faq-5-a: Yes. In each summit form you can set the real date you climbed it and add a photo if you have one. Your progress recalculates automatically.
three-peaks-page.faq-6-q: What other UK challenges can I track?
three-peaks-page.faq-6-a: Beyond the National Three Peaks you can follow the Catalan 100 Cims, French Alps 4000ers, Montes Gallegos and many more — new challenges are added regularly. Follow as many as you want; the same ascent counts for every challenge that contains it.
three-peaks-page.faq-7-a: The app runs on trust: you log your own ascents with a photo and date. There's no mandatory GPS check or external validation. It's a personal tracking tool, not an official competition.
three-peaks-page.disclaimer: Cims, sempre amunt is not affiliated with or endorsed by any mountain authority, national park or federation.
three-peaks-page.cta-subtitle: Install the app, follow the National Three Peaks challenge and start logging your summits. Free, ad-free, made by hikers.

scottish-munros-page.hero-subtitle: The free, ad-free app to track your progress on the 282 Scottish Munros — every mountain in Scotland over 3,000 ft. iOS and Android.
scottish-munros-page.what-is-p1: A Munro is a Scottish mountain with a summit above 3,000 ft (914.4 m). The list was first compiled by Sir Hugh Munro in 1891, and today there are 282 of them — from Ben Nevis (1,345 m), the highest peak in the British Isles, down to the modest hills of the Southern Highlands.
scottish-munros-page.what-is-p2: "Munro bagging" — the tradition of climbing them all — is one of the great British mountaineering challenges. Cims, sempre amunt makes it easy to keep score: mark each summit as done, add a photo and date, and watch your round grow. Most baggers take a lifetime; some do it in a year. Either way, we're with you.
scottish-munros-page.step-1-body: Free on the App Store and Google Play. No complicated signup — log in with Apple or Google and you're ready in seconds.
scottish-munros-page.step-2-body: Pick the Scottish Munros challenge inside the app. All 282 Munros appear in your list with heights, locations and map pins. You can follow other challenges at the same time.
scottish-munros-page.step-3-body: When you reach a summit, open the app, add a photo and the date. Your round updates automatically — share a tick with whoever you want.
scottish-munros-page.featured-subtitle: A random selection of Munros from the app. Inside, you'll find all 282 with heights, map pins and route info.
scottish-munros-page.faq-1-q: How many Munros are there exactly?
scottish-munros-page.faq-1-a: 282 as of the current SMC list. Occasional re-surveys add or remove a peak when a summit is reclassified — we keep the list in sync when the SMC updates theirs.
scottish-munros-page.faq-2-q: Is this app officially endorsed by the SMC?
scottish-munros-page.faq-2-a: No. Cims, sempre amunt is an independent project with no affiliation to the Scottish Mountaineering Club, the National Trust for Scotland, Mountaineering Scotland or any federation. If you want your round officially registered with the SMC, arrange that with them directly.
scottish-munros-page.faq-3-q: How much does the app cost?
scottish-munros-page.faq-3-a: The app is completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. The project is supported by voluntary donations from users who want to help.
scottish-munros-page.faq-4-q: Which platforms is it available on?
scottish-munros-page.faq-4-a: iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. Download it from the App Store or Google Play.
scottish-munros-page.faq-5-q: Can I log Munros I did years ago?
scottish-munros-page.faq-5-a: Yes. In each summit form you can set the real date you climbed it and add a photo if you have one. Your round recalculates automatically, no matter how far back the ascent was.
scottish-munros-page.faq-6-q: What about Corbetts, Grahams, and the other Scottish hills?
scottish-munros-page.faq-6-a: Corbetts and Grahams aren't in the app yet, but they are planned. For now you can follow the Munros alongside other UK lists (the National Three Peaks) and challenges from Spain, France and beyond.
scottish-munros-page.faq-7-a: The app runs on trust: you log your own ascents with a photo and date. There's no mandatory GPS check or external validation. It's a personal tracking tool, not an official competition.
scottish-munros-page.disclaimer: Cims, sempre amunt is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Scottish Mountaineering Club or any federation.
scottish-munros-page.cta-subtitle: Install the app, follow the Scottish Munros, and start ticking off summits. Free, ad-free, made by hikers.

picos-de-europa-page.hero-subtitle: The free, ad-free app to track your progress on the 71 peaks above 2,400 m in Spain's Picos de Europa — Urrieles, Cornión and Ándara massifs. iOS and Android.
picos-de-europa-page.what-is-title: What are the Picos de Europa?
picos-de-europa-page.what-is-p1: The Picos de Europa are a limestone massif in northern Spain, at the eastern end of the Cordillera Cantábrica. They split into three massifs: Urrieles (central, highest), Cornión (western) and Ándara (eastern). They span Asturias, Cantabria and León.
picos-de-europa-page.what-is-p2: Cims, sempre amunt makes it easy to track your progress on the 71 summits over 2,400 m — from Torrecerredo (2,650 m) to the smaller towers and rock spires of the three massifs. Mark each summit with a photo and date and watch your tally grow.
picos-de-europa-page.step-1-body: Free on the App Store and Google Play. No complicated signup — log in with Apple or Google in seconds.
picos-de-europa-page.step-2-body: Pick the Picos de Europa challenge inside the app. All 71 summits appear with height, location and map pins. You can follow other challenges at the same time.
picos-de-europa-page.step-3-body: When you reach a summit, open the app, add a photo and date. Your tally updates automatically and you can share it.
picos-de-europa-page.featured-subtitle: A random selection of Picos summits. Inside the app you'll find all 71 with full details.
picos-de-europa-page.faq-1-q: How many summits are in this challenge?
picos-de-europa-page.faq-1-a: 71 summits above 2,400 m, per the official list based on Spain's IGN (Instituto Geográfico Nacional). Covers all three massifs: Urrieles (highest), Cornión and Ándara.
picos-de-europa-page.faq-2-q: Is this app officially endorsed by the National Park or a federation?
picos-de-europa-page.faq-2-a: No. Cims, sempre amunt is an independent project with no affiliation to the Parque Nacional de los Picos de Europa or any mountaineering federation. For official validation, deal with those bodies directly.
picos-de-europa-page.faq-3-q: How much does the app cost?
picos-de-europa-page.faq-3-a: The app is completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. The project is supported by voluntary donations.
picos-de-europa-page.faq-4-q: Which platforms is it available on?
picos-de-europa-page.faq-4-a: iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. Download from the App Store or Google Play.
picos-de-europa-page.faq-5-q: Can I log summits I climbed years ago?
picos-de-europa-page.faq-5-a: Yes. In each summit form you can set the actual date you climbed it and add a photo. Your tally recalculates automatically.
picos-de-europa-page.faq-6-a: Yes. Beyond the Picos you can follow the Catalan 100 Cims, Cumbres Astures, Top Spain, Altos Madrileños, Camiño das Cimas and more.
picos-de-europa-page.faq-7-a: The app runs on trust: you log your own ascents with photo and date. No mandatory GPS check or external validation. It's a personal tracking tool, not a competition.
picos-de-europa-page.disclaimer: Cims, sempre amunt is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Picos de Europa National Park or any federation.
picos-de-europa-page.cta-subtitle: Install the app, follow the Picos de Europa challenge and start ticking off summits. Free, ad-free, made by hikers.

picos-de-andalucia-page.hero-subtitle: The free, ad-free app to track your progress on Andalusia's 8 provincial high points. iOS and Android.
picos-de-andalucia-page.what-is-title: What are the Picos de Andalucía?
picos-de-andalucia-page.what-is-p1: A classic Andalusian mountaineering challenge: summit the highest peak of each of Andalusia's eight provinces. From Mulhacén (Granada, 3,479 m — the highest peak on mainland Spain) down to Los Bonales (Huelva, 1,064 m), with Chullo, Mágina, Torrecilla, Torreón, Tiñosa and Terril in between.
picos-de-andalucia-page.what-is-p2: Cims, sempre amunt makes it easy: mark each summit with a photo and date and watch your tally grow. Eight peaks, eight provinces, eight very different landscapes — from alpine Sierra Nevada to Mediterranean limestone ridges.
picos-de-andalucia-page.step-1-body: Free on the App Store and Google Play. No complicated signup — log in with Apple or Google in seconds.
picos-de-andalucia-page.step-2-body: Pick the Picos de Andalucía challenge inside the app. All 8 summits appear with height, location and map pins.
picos-de-andalucia-page.step-3-body: When you reach a summit, open the app, add a photo and date. Your tally updates automatically and you can share it.
picos-de-andalucia-page.featured-subtitle: One per province. From Mulhacén (Granada) to Los Bonales (Huelva).
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-1-a: Mulhacén (Granada, 3,479 m), Chullo (Almería, 2,611 m), Pico Mágina (Jaén, 2,167 m), Torrecilla (Málaga, 1,919 m), El Torreón (Cádiz, 1,654 m), Pico de la Tiñosa (Córdoba, 1,570 m), El Terril (Sevilla, 1,128 m) and Los Bonales (Huelva, 1,064 m).
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-2-a: It's a popular regional mountaineering challenge, but there's no single official body that validates it. Various autonomous federations and clubs run their own badges if you want one.
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-3-q: How much does the app cost?
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-3-a: The app is completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. Supported by voluntary donations.
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-4-q: Which platforms is it available on?
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-4-a: iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. Download from the App Store or Google Play.
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-5-q: Can I log summits I climbed years ago?
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-5-a: Yes. In each summit form you can set the actual date you climbed it and add a photo. Your tally recalculates automatically.
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-6-a: Yes. Beyond the Picos de Andalucía you can follow the Picos de Europa, the Catalan 100 Cims, Cumbres Astures, Top Spain, Altos Madrileños, Camiño das Cimas and more.
picos-de-andalucia-page.faq-7-a: The app runs on trust: you log your own ascents with photo and date. No mandatory GPS check or external validation. It's a personal tracking tool, not a competition.
picos-de-andalucia-page.disclaimer: Cims, sempre amunt is not affiliated with or endorsed by any mountaineering federation or official body.
picos-de-andalucia-page.cta-title: Start the Picos de Andalucía today
picos-de-andalucia-page.cta-subtitle: Install the app, follow the challenge and start ticking off summits. Free, ad-free, made by hikers.

cumbres-alicante-page.hero-subtitle: The free, ad-free app to track your progress on Alicante province's 11 iconic peaks. iOS and Android.
cumbres-alicante-page.what-is-title: What are the Cumbres de Alicante?
cumbres-alicante-page.what-is-p1: A curated selection of the eleven most iconic summits of Alicante province: from Sierra de Aitana (1,558 m), the provincial high point, down to the iconic Peñón de Ifach (332 m) rising above the Mediterranean. Covers the big inland ranges — Mariola, Serrella, Maigmó — and the coastal viewpoints of the Marina.
cumbres-alicante-page.what-is-p2: Cims, sempre amunt makes it easy: mark each summit with a photo and date and watch your tally grow. Eleven peaks to discover the deep Alicante, from high mountain to the coast.
cumbres-alicante-page.step-1-body: Free on the App Store and Google Play. No complicated signup — log in with Apple or Google in seconds.
cumbres-alicante-page.step-2-body: Pick the Cumbres de Alicante challenge inside the app. All 11 summits appear with height, location and map pins.
cumbres-alicante-page.step-3-body: When you reach a summit, open the app, add a photo and date. Your tally updates automatically and you can share it.
cumbres-alicante-page.featured-subtitle: From the provincial high point in Sierra de Aitana to the Peñón de Ifach above the Mediterranean.
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-1-a: Aitana (1,558 m), Puig Campana (1,406 m), Montcabrer (1,390 m), Serrella (1,379 m), El Menejador (1,354 m), Maigmó (1,296 m), Cabeçó d'Or (1,210 m), Ponoig (1,181 m), Sierra de Bernia (1,129 m), Montgó (753 m) and Peñón de Ifach (332 m).
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-2-q: Is this the official CEdA list?
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-2-a: No. It's a curated selection of iconic peaks. The CEdA (Centro Excursionista d'Alcoi) maintains a more ambitious 100-peak challenge; this one is compact, for getting started.
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-3-q: How much does the app cost?
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-3-a: Completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. Supported by voluntary donations.
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-4-q: Which platforms is it available on?
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-4-a: iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. Download from the App Store or Google Play.
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-5-q: Can I log summits I climbed years ago?
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-5-a: Yes. Set the actual date and add a photo. Your tally recalculates automatically.
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-6-q: Are there other Valencia / Levante challenges?
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-6-a: Yes. Beyond Cumbres de Alicante you can follow Cumbres del Levante, which covers the whole Comunidad Valenciana, alongside many other Spanish challenges.
cumbres-alicante-page.faq-7-a: The app runs on trust: you log your own ascents with photo and date. No mandatory GPS check or external validation. It's a personal tracking tool, not a competition.
cumbres-alicante-page.disclaimer: Cims, sempre amunt is not affiliated with or endorsed by the CEdA or any mountaineering federation.
cumbres-alicante-page.cta-subtitle: Install the app, follow the challenge and start ticking off summits. Free, ad-free, made by hikers.
